_comment: T049 - the demonstration's sample work item (FR-032).
The single copy: the self-contained run loads this file, and the operator
copies these fields into the collection when creating the live work item.
Six acceptance criteria, chosen so the review has all three verdicts to give:
4           the change does NOT satisfy, and the pull request description
claims it does       -> the headline false coverage claim
6           the change does not touch, and nobody claims it does
-> not addressed, which is NEUTRAL and never a defect

fields.System.Title: Add items to the shopping cart
fields.System.Description: As a shopper, I want to add items to my shopping cart so that I can buy several products in one order.
fields.Microsoft.VSTS.Common.AcceptanceCriteria:
• Quantity must be a positive integer; a request with zero or a negative quantity is rejected with a validation error.
  • Adding an unknown product returns a not-found response and does not change the cart.
  • Adding a product already in the cart increments the quantity of the existing line instead of appending a second line.
  • The system must not allow adding more items than are available in stock; a request exceeding available stock is rejected.
  • The cart total is recalculated after a successful add, before the cart is saved.
  • A shopper can remove a single line from the cart without emptying it.
